subject: Consolidated SKU packaging & reseller pass-through for private offer
messages:
From: Ashley Chen <ashley@novaai.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.inference>
Cc: CloudBroker Sales Ops <salesops@cloudbroker.io>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer - SKU consolidation + channel pass-through question

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo last week — NovaAI is excited about the latency profile on your hosted endpoints. We're preparing a private offer request for GCP and have a couple of asks where we need guidance:

1) SKU consolidation: our product team wants a simplified SKU (metered compute + optional premium prompt-optimizations bundle). Can Redwood map multiple billing SKUs into a single private-offer line item while preserving per-feature usage visibility?

2) Channel pass-through: we plan to route through CloudBroker as our preferred reseller. They need a clear commission waterfall in the PO (reseller fee as pass-through from list price). Can you confirm the mechanics (net vs list treatment) and whether there's precedent for an "uplift" credit in year 1 to fund partner enablement?

Attached is a rough SKU draft for context (novaai-sku-draft.pdf). We're on a tight timeline — trying to get a partner-ready PO by end of month.

Would love a short call with you + Ben/Finance to align.

Best,
Ashley

+1 (415) 555-0192

Subject: Re: Private offer - SKU consolidation + channel pass-through question

Ashley — thanks for the clear brief and the draft. Copying Ben (Channel) and Tessa (Finance) to get practical stove-piping on the options. Quick answers up-front, then proposed next steps: 

Summary answers: 
- SKU consolidation: yes, we can present a single private-offer line item that bills metered usage and an add-on feature flag. Internally we still surface per-feature telemetry for reporting; we can feed NovaAI that breakdown for invoicing/usage reconciliation.
- Channel pass-through: we support reseller pass-through from List Price. The PO can reflect the partner commission as a separate contract line (so the marketplace shows the list price and the net revenue after reseller fee).

Immediate asks for us to model: 
- Target partner gross margin (what NovaAI expects CloudBroker to receive).
- Whether NovaAI wants the partner uplift to be an up-front credit (one-time) or a blended % uplift across year 1 usage.
- Any list-price floor you need for subsequent partner tokenization.

Attachments: I'll share our recommended commission waterfall workbook for modeling. Can we schedule a 30-min alignment tomorrow?

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Private offer - SKU consolidation + channel pass-through question

Olga / team — dug into this and sketched a neutral-first commission waterfall we use in similar marketplace POs. Key points below; workbook attached (commission-waterfall.xlsx).

Proposal (high level):
- List price stays as the public/private-offer list. Reseller pass-through is applied as a separate line item (so NovaAI sees list, CloudBroker receives a commission derived from list).
- Typical waterfall we recommend: 8% reseller fee (CloudBroker), 3% broker fee to aggregator if applicable, then a 2% implementation enablement credit applied as a one-time credit against the first invoice (or spread over first 3 invoices on request).
- If NovaAI needs a year-1 uplift to compensate partners for enablement, we can structure as either: (A) a one-time credit paid from Redwood to the partner via a settlement ledger, or (B) a blended +4% on list for months 1-3 that is visible in the PO as a temporary uplift. Option A keeps list price clean; option B is simpler for partner cash flow.

Operational notes / risks:
- Deep discount stacking (large % off list + uplift) can create negative net revenue after partner fees for low-usage customers — recommend a minimum net-rev floor per SKU (see Tessa's note).
- SKU consolidation will require us to expose metering dimensions in the private-offer metadata so NovaAI and CloudBroker can reconcile per-feature usage for downstream billing. That is standard but requires a brief mapping exercise.

Next steps:
1) Confirm NovaAI's target partner payout (gross $ or %).
2) Confirm preference for one-time credit vs blended uplift.
3) Finance to confirm minimum net-rev floor and true-up cadence.

Ben Carter
Senior Channel Manager | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.inference

Attachment: commission-waterfall.xlsx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa@redwood.inference>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer - SKU consolidation + channel pass-through question

Team — quick finance guardrails so we model correctly (note: see finance-note.txt attached for the short rationale).

Finance constraints: 
- Minimum net revenue floor: $0.07 per 1k token-equivalent or equivalent metric on metered billing. Below this the unit economics are negative after partner fees and infra.
- Early-adopter / enablement credit: acceptable up to a one-time $25k cap per partner for new POs (or 10% of first year expected net revenue, whichever is lower). Credits must be invoiced as a settlement line — we cannot show them as permanent list price increases.
- True-up cadence: quarterly true-up recommended for metered offers with pass-through; monthly increases ops complexity and delays partner settlement.
- Tax & marketplace fees: marketplace platforms often levy a ~3% fee; model that into the waterfall before calculating partner payout.

If NovaAI is targeting a partner gross payout of >12% of list we need to model lower net rev and consider a smaller uplift or longer amortization of credits.

Tessa Morgan
Revenue Operations / Finance | Redwood Inference
tessa@redwood.inference

Attachment: finance-note.txt

Subject: Re: Private offer - SKU consolidation + channel pass-through question

Ashley — looping back with a consolidated set of options and a recommended path so your PO timeline stays intact. Short summary below; attached are the modeling files and finance guardrail.

Recommended path (lowest friction to close):
- Private-offer line: single consolidated SKU (metered compute + premium prompts add-on). We will surface per-feature usage for reconciliation but present one invoice line to the marketplace.
- Partner compensation: 8% reseller fee + 3% broker fee, with a one-time enablement credit option of up to $25k (per Tessa) applied as a settlement on first invoice. This mirrors Option A in Ben's note (one-time credit).
- List-price floor: must model a minimum net revenue of $0.07 / 1k token-equivalent to protect unit economics. If NovaAI's target partner payout is higher than the waterfall above, we will need to either reduce uplift or extend the credit amortization to 6-12 months.
- True-up: quarterly.

Next steps / asks from NovaAI:
- Confirm target gross payout for CloudBroker (percent or $).
- Confirm whether you prefer one-time credit (we manage via settlement) or a temporary % uplift on months 1-3.
- If yes to one-time credit, please sign the attached partner settlement addendum via DocuSign here: https://www.docusign.com/rcp/embeddedSigning?token=abc123

We'll draft the private-offer bundle and push to the GCP marketplace once terms are agreed. I'll schedule a 30-min wrap-up for Monday to sign off.

Thanks,
